ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, legal representatives and authorized signatories must be screened against the State Bank of Viet Nam FIU database, the Vietnamese consolidated AML/CFT blacklist, UN Security Council Consolidated List as adopted by Viet Nam, OFAC SDN List, FATF public statements, and relevant PEP databases. Risk-based KYCM/CDD must be performed by the licensed bank and the incorporation agent before funds transfer or acceptance of subscription; any suspicious transaction must be reported under Law No. 14/2022/QH15.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal – Cổng Thông Tin Quốc Gia Về Đăng Ký Doanh Nghiệp (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Enterprise names must be in Vietnamese script, must include the legal form suffix 'Trách nhiệm hữu hạn' or 'TNHH' for a limited liability company, and may be accompanied by an abbreviated or foreign-language name. A foreign investor's intended corporate name must be transliterated into phonetically faithful Vietnamese characters unless a registered trademark or well-known mark supports retention of the original Latin script. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing enterprise in the National Business Registration Database.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Ngân hàng (Bank) – prior State Bank approval required
Bảo hiểm (Insurance) – prior Ministry of Finance approval required
Chứng khoán (Securities) – prior State Securities Commission approval required
Quân đội (Military) – prohibited without ministerial authorization
Công an (Police / Public Security) – prohibited without ministerial authorization
Chính phủ (Government) – prohibited absent special statutory mandate
Trường đại học (University) – prior Ministry of Education and Training approval required
Dược phẩm (Pharmaceutical) – prior Ministry of Health approval required
Phát thanh / Truyền hình (Radio / Television) – prior Ministry of Information and Communications authorization required
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or its incorporated agent may file an administrative complaint with the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) within 30 days of the written refusal, under Law No. 11/2015/QH13 on Complaints and Denunciations. If the DPI upholds the rejection, the applicant may initiate an administrative lawsuit at the competent provincial People's Court within 30 days of the DPI decision. Alternatively, a corrected name and transliteration may be re-submitted immediately through the National Business Registration Portal; a name reservation cannot be extended beyond 30 days and lapses automatically, requiring a new reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole registered office. A physical head-office address inside Viet Nam is mandatory for the Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate. A serviced or coworking office with a valid lease and physical access may qualify; a mail-forwarding-only or virtual desk arrangement does not satisfy commercial-substance requirements. For an AAA game 3D-art outsourcing studio, a dedicated leased studio with active equipment and personnel is strongly recommended to evidence entity-level substance and reduce tax-residency challenges.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-low. Baseline unannounced on-site inspection probability is approximately 8–12% per year for a low-risk creative BPO LLC with foreign investors. The probability rises to 20–25% per year if the company files a VAT refund, engages in high-value cross-border payments, or undergoes a transfer-pricing audit.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Enterprise Law 2020), Articles 24-28 (establishment procedures), Articles 30-34 (limited liability company charter and registration), Articles 46-50 (registered office and legal representative), Articles 55-60 (capital contribution and member rights), together with Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 for foreign-invested enterprise procedures, and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office, Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment, via the National Business Registration Portal; in practice, the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) for foreign-invested enterprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp), accompanied by the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) and member/appointment documents, plus the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for foreign-invested LLCs.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital for a general LLC under Enterprise Law 2020; charter capital must be fully contributed within 90 days after the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued. For foreign investors, the IRC may specify a committed capital amount, and a blocked/escrow bank account is recommended to demonstrate capital availability and to ensure lawful contribution remittance into Vietnam. Capital must be licensed at a commercial bank in Vietnam, and contribution schedule must be maintained.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION NO. 01-/[YYYY] OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS/MEMBER'S COUNCIL OF [VIETNAMESE COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

Adopted on: [date] at [city/province], Viet Nam

WHEREAS, the company has been duly incorporated under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Enterprise Registration Certificate No. [registration number];

NOW, THEREFORE, the founding members/member's council hereby resolve as follows:

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND CONTRIBUTION: The charter capital of the company is fixed at [VND amount in words and figures], divided as follows: [Member A] subscribes [VND amount], being [percentage]% of the charter capital; [Member B] subscribes [VND amount], being [percentage]%; [and so on]. Each member shall contribute the full subscribed capital within 90 days from the date of the Enterprise Registration Certificate by wire transfer to the company's bank account No. [account number] at [bank name], and shall receive a capital contribution confirmation certificate. All funds must be documented and reported in accordance with applicable Vietnamese foreign exchange and tax laws.

2. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: The registered office of the company is adopted as: [full address, ward, district, province/city], Viet Nam. The Company shall maintain its statutory corporate records, seals, and legal service address at this location, and the General Director/legal representative is authorized to execute the office lease agreement and all related contracts.

3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: The following officers are appointed:
(i) [Full name] as Chairperson/General Director, the legal representative of the Company, with authority to sign all binding contracts, open and operate bank accounts, hire and manage personnel, execute corporate filings, and represent the Company before all authorities;
(ii) [Full name] as Chief Financial Officer / Head of Accounting, responsible for accounting records, tax declarations, payroll, and corporate finance;
(iii) [Full name] as Studio Director / Operations Manager, responsible for production, delivery of services, and day-to-day operations of the 3D game art studio.

4. GOVERNANCE: The Company shall adopt a company seal registered with the Business Registration Office, maintain a member registry, meeting minutes, and statutory accounting books under the Law on Enterprises and Law on Accounting. Any change to this resolution requires the approval of members holding at least [percentage]% of charter capital in accordance with the Charter.

5. EFFECTIVENESS: This resolution takes effect immediately and shall be filed in the corporate records.

ADOPTED unanimously by the founding members.

[Signature block of all members, Chairperson/General Director, Company Seal]

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration and Investment Policy Approval (if required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment; for projects above the delegation threshold, the Ministry of Planning and Investment or the Prime Minister
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Investment Project Proposal and Application for Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) under Law on Investment 2020. Include the project's economic-technical explanation, business scope (ISIC 7490 - creative game art outsourcing), proposed charter capital, location of registered office, and investor capacity proof. For 100% foreign-owned LLCs, do the filing in the prescribed form through the National Investment Information System or at the DPI counter. Verify that the business line is not in the list of conditional market access sectors for foreign investors. Upon approval, the IRC will be issued and later integrated with the ERC.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Project Registration
Investment project proposal or business plan
Certificate of incorporation / passport of the foreign investor (notarized, legalized/apostilled, translated into Vietnamese)
Audited financial statements of the investor (or bank confirmation of financial capability) for the past fiscal year
Joint venture or investment contract (if applicable)
Proposed charter capital contribution schedule and bank proof of capital availability
Location lease intention or certificate of the proposed registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a request for revision or additional documents, respond within 30 days with corrected filings. If the IRC is denied, file a written complaint/application for reconsideration to the same authority, and if still unresolved, appeal to the provincial People's Committee or initiate administrative court proceedings under the Law on Administrative Procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Business Scope Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal / Business Registration Office under the Ministry of Planning and Investment (via provincial DPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a proposed-name search on the National Business Registration Portal. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any previously registered enterprise and must include 'Limited Liability Company' or appropriate Vietnamese legal form designation. Prepare the Vietnamese and English name consistent with the company's legal form. Verify that the primary business scope code ISIC 7490 / NAICS 541430 (other professional, scientific and technical activities; computer graphic services) is truly non-conditional and requires no separate business license. The name can be reserved as part of the consolidated registration application or by a standalone name reservation form on the Portal.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (Vietnamese and English)
Name search / reservation request form
Business scope description including 3D game art, sculpting, rigging, and outsourcing services
Passport / legal status documents of persons authorized to file
Power of attorney to the filing agent (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, quickly select two alternative names and resubmit the name reservation form. If business scope is flagged as conditional, apply for the corresponding conditional business license or narrow the wording to non-conditional activities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Company Charter and Founding Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in province/city of the registered office; for foreign documents, Vietnamese consular/legalization services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Company Charter following the standard template of Enterprise Law 2020, containing company name, type, legal form, address, business lines, charter capital, member's capital contributions, management structure, legal representative, meeting rules, and dissolution provisions. Execute the Charter and the minutes of the founding members' meeting before a notary. Translate all foreign corporate resolutions and identity documents into Vietnamese; legalize/apostille according to Vietnam's treaty obligations. Ensure the person authorized to sign Vietnamese documents holds a valid power of attorney and valid passport.
required_dossiers: Draft Company Charter (Vietnamese)
Minutes of the Founding Members' Meeting approving the Charter
List of founding members and capital contribution ratios
Notarized identity documents of all founding members (passport, Vietnam ID card as applicable)
Legal entity status documents of corporate members (Certificate of Incorporation, business registration) with consular legalization and Vietnamese translation
Power of attorney for representative(s) filing the dossier
Lease agreement or proof of right to use registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary challenges missing translations or authorizations, cure by obtaining proper legalization of foreign documents and new signatures. Correct any inconsistency in the Charter and re-notarize only the affected signature pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Consolidated Enterprise Registration Dossier on the National Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal / provincial Department of Planning and Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete enterprise registration dossier online or physically at the DPI, including the Application for Enterprise Registration (Form A-01), the Charter, member list, capital contribution schedule, legal representative appointment, and the IRC (if already issued). Pay the state fee via the integrated payment gateway. Track the dossier status electronically; the Business Registration Office will review for completeness and legal compliance under Decrees 01/2021/ND-CP and 122/2021/ND-CP.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form A-01)
Company Charter notarized/certified
List of founding members and their capital contributions
Certified copies of members' identity or legal-status documents
List of legal representative(s) and their consent documents
Investment Registration Certificate (for foreign-invested companies)
Power of attorney to a filing agent (if any)
Receipt of fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, use the portal's 'revision' workflow to submit supplementary documents. Address the DPI's written comments within 15 working days; otherwise the application lapses. If illegal refusal occurs, file a complaint to the DPI head, and subsequently to the provincial People's Committee or the Ministry of Planning and Investment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Enterprise Registration Certificate and Automatic Tax Identification Number Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office (DPI); General Department of Taxation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) containing the company name, ERC number, legal form, business line, registered office, legal representative, and charter capital. The General Department of Taxation will automatically issue the tax identification number (TIN) of the enterprise. Complete the seal registration by submitting the seal specimen notice online to the Business Registration Office (within 15 days of the seal's first use), order the physical company seal with the registered seal registration code, and open a bank account at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
TIN notification from GDT
Corporate seal specimen notice (electronic form)
Corporate seal registration certificate / code
Bank account opening documents (in practice, the ERC and TIN; the account is opened at the chosen bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ERC contains errors, file an application for amendment of the ERC with the DPI. If the TIN is not issued automatically, contact the provincial tax department with the ERC and solve data synchronization issues. If seal specimen notice is rejected, promptly correct the electronic declaration and resubmit before using the seal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Tax Registration, Electronic Invoicing, and Social/Labor Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Department (sub-department of taxation), Social Insurance Agency, Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after the ERC, file the initial tax registration and declaration forms with the tax authority, including the adoption of the tax regime (monthly/quarterly VAT, annual CIT), and register the electronic invoicing system under Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Register as an employer for social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance with the VSS; submit labor relocation lists and internal labor regulations to the DOLISA for enterprises with 10 or more employees. Register the physical workplace with DOLISA for occupational safety; open a payroll account and authorize salary payments through a licensed bank.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Tax registration and declaration forms (Form ĐK-TCT / as applicable)
Electronic invoice registration form and digital certificate
Social insurance employer registration form (Form TK-TS)
List of employees and labor contracts (if known at this stage)
Internal labor regulations registration dossier (if hiring 10+ employees)
Occupational safety and hygiene risk assessment and registration form
Workplace/address documentation for the studio
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration fails due to data mismatch, file a written correction request to the local tax sub-department with the ERC and passport/identity documents. If social insurance registration is late, pay the corresponding shortfall and penalties, and submit an explanation letter to the Social Insurance Agency.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Provincial Department of Industry and Trade (DOIT) for industrial/commercial operation oversight, together with the Department of Planning and Investment for investment compliance, and the Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs for occupational safety.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) with the business line code ISIC 7490 (other professional, scientific and technical activities) and supporting description 'Creative 3D game art outsourcing, sculpting, rigging, and production services'. No separate operating license is statutorily mandated for this non-conditional business line; however the company continues to hold the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) as the foreign investment license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) / Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). This office/software/3D art studio falls under a low-environmental-impact category requiring only an Environmental Protection Commitment (EPC) registration or a simplified environmental license under the Law on Environmental Protection 2020 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP, to be filed with the commune/ward People's Committee or DONRE as applicable.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Must comply with QCVN 40:2011/BTNMT (industrial wastewater) for any relevant wastewater discharge (domestic wastewater from office: route to municipal sewerage in accordance with Local Law), QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT (industrial emissions) for negligible airborne pollutants, and QCVN 03-MT:2015/BTNMT for hazardous substances in soil and groundwater. E-waste (computers, GPUs, monitors, lithium batteries) must be managed under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP and national technical regulations on hazardous waste; maintain waste transfer slips with licensed treatment providers. Work environment air quality must meet QCVN 22:2016/BYT. The studio shall also comply with occupational exposure to electromagnetic fields and lighting standards as per the Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (Phê duyệt/ nghiệm thu về phòng cháy chữa cháy) must be obtained from the provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP before the physical studio is put into operation. Conduct an annual fire inspection of the office floor, ensure fire alarm and extinguishing equipment, emergency exits, and evacuation plans. Obtain a structural load certificate/structural acceptance for the leased floor confirming it can bear the concentrated load of render servers and GPU workstations from a licensed construction inspection company. Comply with Decree 44/2016/ND-CP for construction and equipment quality. Carry out mandatory occupational safety training, workplace health risk assessment (software indicated: low-risk office but still mandatory), electrical safety inspection, and register the facility with the district labor safety authority. In addition, although not a license, file a registration for the use of laser or high-intensity electronic devices if used; otherwise no further clearance is required for non-industrial 3D art production.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tong Cuc Thue) of the Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam; official e-portal: thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-Tax Portal) and etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation of a foreign-invested LLC, the provincial Department of Planning and Investment issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate and simultaneously assigns the statutory Tax Identification Number (Ma So Thue). Tax registration is integrated with enterprise registration; the LLC must then activate the e-Tax account on the General Department of Taxation portal within the prescribed statutory window, submit its legal representative authorization and digital certificate, and complete VAT and CIT registration formalities. Non-resident entities without a permanent establishment may separately register under the Decree 126/2020/ND-CP withholding mechanism for indirect tax compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity election is available under Vietnamese law. An LLC is mandatorily taxed at entity level as a resident corporate taxpayer at the 20% CIT standard rate. Statutory elections are limited to: (a) VAT computation method election between the credit/deduction method (khau tru) and the direct method (truc tiep) for eligible taxpayers below prescribed revenue thresholds; and (b) election of the CIT incentives regime (e.g., high-tech, export-processing enterprise or new-investment incentive certificate) where statutory qualification criteria are satisfied. Thin capitalization (30% EBITDA interest cap), transfer-pricing documentation and consolidation elections are not permitted deviations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Thue Gia Tri Gia Tang)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 100,000,000 annual turnover for household and individual businesses; foreign-invested LLCs are subject to mandatory VAT registration without any turnover threshold upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory nationwide e-invoicing under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC effective 1 July 2022. Taxpayers must issue e-invoices in standardized XML format through GDT-approved e-invoice service providers. Two authentication mechanisms are mandatory: (1) e-invoices with tax authority clearance code — the digital invoice file is transmitted in near-real-time via API to the GDT e-invoice portal, which immediately validates and returns the authority code; and (2) e-invoices without tax authority code bearing a qualified digital signature, with invoice data files transmitted to thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn no later than the statutory VAT return filing deadline (20th of the following month for monthly filers; 30th of the quarter-end for quarterly filers). Real-time fiscal clearance through e-Customs integration (VNACCS/VCIS) applies to export declarations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero percent VAT applies to exported goods physically leaving Viet Nam, including supplies to export-processing enterprises (EPEs), bonded warehouses and non-tariff zones, and to services rendered to foreign organizations/individuals and consumed outside Viet Nam. Conditions include: a written cross-border contract stipulating the supply of goods or services and payment terms; customs export declaration for goods; non-cash settlement through a bank or eligible intermediary; and, for services, evidence that the service is performed entirely or predominantly outside Viet Nam and that the foreign principal bears the cost. For the AAA game 3D art outsourcing model, eligibility is available where the creative BPO service is supplied directly to an overseas principal under contract, delivered electronically, and paid via SWIFT wire transfer or PayPal with an inward remittance record; services consumed domestically or performed within Viet Nam for domestic parties remain subject to the standard 10% rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Viet Nam e-Customs Export Declaration (electronic V5/V6 declaration with VNACCS clearance)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export
Signed overseas export contract / Statement of Work / Master Services Agreement
Bank SWIFT MT103 / Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) evidencing foreign-currency remittance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating and VAT refund claims are subject to retrospective inspection under the Law on Tax Administration (No. 38/2019/QH14). The ordinary inspection period is five years from the end of the liability year; the limitation period extends to ten years where fraud is identified. Penalties include administrative fines up to VND 500,000,000 per violation, 20% late-payment interest per month on clawed-back refunds, 100% disgorgement of wrongfully claimed offsettings with daily interest surcharge, and suspension or revocation of the e-invoice clearance status. Criminal liability under Penal Code Articles 200 and 201 may attach with fines up to VND 4.5 billion and custodial sentences up to 20 years for organized tax evasion or invoice forgery.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam maintains a managed floating exchange rate regime with the Vietnamese Dong (VND) as the domestic currency. Current account transactions, including cross-border service fees and profit remittances arising from licensed foreign-invested enterprises, are generally convertible for legitimate commercial purposes subject to SBV-accredited bank processing and supporting documentation. Capital account transactions, including FDI equity contributions and withdrawals, remain restricted and require prior licensing, the opening of a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA), and annual tax clearance. Profit remittance is permitted once the audited annual financial statements are approved and the corporate income tax finalization obligation is satisfied, but the bank will apply a 0.5% withholding tax rate on profit transfers to foreign shareholders pursuant to the relevant double tax treaty provisions or domestic regulations, as applicable. No significant hurdles arise in the current account conversion for a low-risk creative BPO receiving confirmed purchase orders from international game publishers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SBV Ordinance on Foreign Exchange and Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN (as amended), all export proceeds derived from the provision of services to non-residents by Vietnamese companies, including game art outsourcing, must be repatriated to Vietnam by crediting the receipts to a foreign currency account held at a licensed domestic bank within no more than 180 days from the date of service completion or contractual settlement date, whichever occurs later. There is no mandatory conversion of foreign currency proceeds into VND at any fixed ratio; however, the enterprise may retain foreign currency balances in its account, and the bank will effect conversions to VND upon request at the prevailing market rate. Export service invoices must be accompanied by the signed service agreement, delivery of digital assets, and payment records to evidence the underlying transaction identity for foreign exchange registration purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietcombank (Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) and VND Operating Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BIDV (Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) and USD/EUR Foreign Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary treasury usage. Offshore fintech EMIs and digital banking platforms such as Wise, Payoneer, and Airwallex are not licensed deposit-taking institutions in Vietnam and are not permitted to open VND accounts, provide payment aggregation within Vietnam, or act as the settlement rail for inbound FDI repatriation or statutory foreign exchange registrations. These platforms may be used solely as secondary channels for collecting small-value client remittances from abroad, which must then be swept into the licensed domestic bank account through a compliant SWIFT inbound transfer. PayPal is likewise viable only as a receivable collection tool under the low-risk payment rails identified in the target payload; PayPal Vietnam operates under the SBV's payment intermediary licensing framework, and all withdrawals must ultimately terminate in a Vietnamese commercial bank account with full underlying export service documentation maintained for AML and FX reporting.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The general director or an authorized signatory holding a notarized and legalized Power of Attorney must physically appear before the bank's compliance officer at a branch in a major Vietnamese financial hub, typically Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City. Remote opening in the absence of any local physical presence is not permitted for foreign-invested companies. Virtual interview processes may supplement but never replace the mandatory physical first meeting for final execution of the account opening agreement and specimen signature card. A foreign corporate representative residing overseas may execute the POA at a Vietnamese consulate or by apostilled notarization, but the bank in practice requires one senior executive physically present in Vietnam for the final verification and e-KYC enrolment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership chain including non-resident shareholders in jurisdictions with limited financial transparency
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete corporate registry extract, certified articles of association demonstrating the direct and indirect ownership tree, passports of all natural persons holding 25% or more ownership, apostilled and certified copies of shareholders' resolutions, and a sworn beneficial ownership declaration executed before a Vietnamese notary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between registered equity capital and forecast high-frequency international payment throughput for a 3D art outsourcing studio
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized English-language contracts with global game studios, invoice and payment history reports, a 12-month cash flow projection, the ERC, the IRC, and a business background memorandum explaining studio operating expenses, artist payroll exposure, and software licensing costs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipt accumulation from PayPal or other third-party intermediaries rather than from direct counterparties, triggering the risk of unverified trade funding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PayPal settlement statements matched to individual purchase orders, platform terms and conditions as proof of legitimate marketplace activity, a client-verified invoice register, sandbox artwork delivery logs, and an undertaking that any such payments will subsequently be credited to the licensed corporate account within the statutory FX repatriation window.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear sourcing of initial paid-in capital where the foreign investor's funds are held in digital asset intermediaries or offshore high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements from the remitting financial institution covering at least 12 months, sworn capital source declarations, relevant certificates of incorporation and good standing, and a structured funding route map identifying each intermediary to allow the bank to complete enhanced due diligence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections must be executed through the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened in the name of the VN LLC at an SBV-licensed commercial bank after the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC). The foreign investor shall wire funds via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own overseas bank account, referencing the IRC number and the purpose code based on the IMF Balance of Payments classification for direct investment equity capital (category 7.1.1 or the SBV-designated code for FDI capital contribution under Circular 06/2019/TT-NHNN). The bank will verify the remitter's name against the registered shareholder, obtain the underlying equity transfer agreement if applicable, and issue a capital contribution voucher upon crediting funds. All inflows must be supported by the written capital injection schedule and board resolution approving the funding, and any funds from PayPal or intermediary platforms cannot be routed into the DICA; PayPal collections must first enter a separate ordinary foreign currency account only after conversion of the sales ledger into verifiable invoices.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Routine payments to overseas subcontractors, royalty holders, and software licensors shall be cleared via SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers through the domestic licensed bank's corresponding network, with each instruction containing the precise commercial payment narrative and transaction purpose code. Bankatory letters of credit are not typical for service exports but may be used at counterparty request under UCP600 for milestone-gated 3D art deliverables; the domestic bank will issue or confirm standby commercial LCs backed by the client's purchase order. All outbound trade disbursements must be reconciled against underlying service agreements and goods/services descriptions, and any disbursement in excess of USD 50,000 equivalent triggers documentary review requiring the invoice, delivery acceptance certificate, tax receipt, and payment instruction matching the foreign exchange application form (Form 02) under Circular 23/2019/TT-NHNN. Sweep mechanisms from PayPal and other e-money aggregators into the operating account shall be effected weekly using batch MT103s, with full audit trails retained in the treasury ERP for realization and revenue recognition purposes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX Forwards executed with licensed Vietnamese commercial banks for maturities up to 365 days, hedged against the USD/VND exchange rate and supported by underlying receivables from game publishing clients
FX Swaps (swap of VND against foreign currency) as permitted by SBV regulations, used to manage temporary VND liquidity mismatches without speculative purpose

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) authorized for foreign-invested enterprises strictly for hedging the residual conversion risk on committed export proceeds, executed offshore with parent company treasury against VND with settlement in USD

Currency Options purchased from licensed foreign bank branches in Vietnam provided the economic exposure arises from documented foreign currency receivables and the hedge is proportionate to expected cash flows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax finalization return (Form 03/TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via the provincial Sub-Department of Taxation; e-filed on the national e-tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due no later than the 30th day of the 3rd month after fiscal-year end; calendar-year taxpayers must file by 31 March of the following year (Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-submission fines escalate from VND 2,000,000 to VND 25,000,000 under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; outstanding tax bears late-payment interest of 0.03% per day; sustained non-compliance triggers invoice suspension, enforced collection, and DPI revocation of enterprise registration (administrative strike-off).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation / provincial Sub-Department of Taxation and the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the accounting year-end; calendar-year enterprises must submit by 31 March of the following year (Law on Accounting No. 88/2015/QH13)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to VND 20,000,000 for late or non-delivery under the accounting-sanction regime; tax authorities may re-determine assessable CIT and declared figures; persistent omission can lead to revocation of enterprise registration by DPI.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual investment project implementation report for the FDI project
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (Investment Registration Agency) under Decree 09/2021/ND-CP
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual report due by 31 March of the following calendar year; quarterly reports due within 30 days after each quarter-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines and compliance orders under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; serious or repeated violation may suspend the investment project and lead to forced termination and withdrawal of the Investment Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual labor utilization report (Báo cáo sử dụng lao động)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 15 December of the reporting year (Labor Code 2019 and implementing decrees)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of VND 5,000,000–10,000,000 for failure to submit or falsification of the report; repeat violation triggers labor inspection and compulsory corrective measures.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies to all foreign-invested enterprises (including this LLC) irrespective of revenue or asset size; audit is also compulsory for public companies, credit institutions, insurers, state-owned enterprises, and other enterprises designated by law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) as implemented by Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS may be applied for consolidated or group reporting only where permitted under Decision 345/2020/QD-BTC, and FDI groups commonly reconcile audited VAS financial statements to IFRS for head-office consolidation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation is filed in Viet Nam. The LLC must keep its Register of Members continuously accurate at the head office, record every capital-interest transfer in the register, and notify the Provincial DPI of any membership or charter-capital change within 10 days under the Law on Enterprise 2020.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450–900 per year (registered office address, corporate secretarial filing support, and retaining accounting/tax agency)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–3,000 per year (audit of one calendar year for a small foreign-invested LLC)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A foreign-invested LLC engaged in 3D game art outsourcing is subject to the standard 20% CIT rate. Preferential CIT rates (e.g., 10% for 15 years, tax holidays, and 50% reduction) are generally available only for investment projects in encouraged sectors or specified geographical areas, and outsourced game art services do not automatically qualify without an investment incentive certificate. Software production and digital content services meeting the criteria of the Law on High Technology may qualify for preferential rates. Small and medium enterprises with annual revenue not exceeding VND 3 billion may benefit from reduced rates: 15% for the first 2 years and 10% for the following 4 years, subject to conditions. Enterprises providing outsourcing services must verify eligibility with the competent investment authority.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/TNDN (quarterly provisional CIT declaration) and Form 01/TNDN (annual CIT finalization return), filed through the electronic tax portal of the General Department of Taxation (etax.gdt.gov.vn) / ThuDienTu system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly provisional CIT declarations and payments are due no later than the 30th day of the first month of the next quarter. The annual CIT finalization return is due on the 30th day of the third month following the end of the fiscal year (e.g., 30 March for a calendar year-end). Provisional quarterly payments must reach at least 80% of the final annual CIT liability, otherwise a penalty of 0.03% per day on the shortfall may apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer name, tax ID, address, legal representative, fiscal year, and investment registration certificate number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign-invested LLC must use its Vietnam tax identification number; ultimate foreign parent and foreign investor details are disclosed pursuant to related-party transaction schedules if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from sale of 3D art outsourcing services, net of deductions and VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognized on an accrual basis in accordance with Vietnamese Accounting Standards. Revenue generated from foreign clients under BPO contracts is fully taxable in Vietnam as sourced from the enterprise's activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses directly incurred in generating revenue, plus depreciation, salary, subcontracting costs, software and equipment, and other permissible deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses paid to foreign related parties are deductible only if supported by valid contracts, invoices, proof of actual payment, and compliant transfer pricing documentation. Unsubstantiated or non-commercial cross-border charges may be disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue less deductible expenses, adjusted by non-deductible expenditures and tax-exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC computes taxable income from all global activities of the Vietnam entity; no ring-fencing based on foreign client location.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year tax losses applied against current-year income within the 5-year carryforward window.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward continuously for a maximum of 5 years from the year following the loss year. No loss carryback is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable corporate income tax rate applied to taxable income (standard 20% or preferential rate).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 3D art outsourcing LLC must apply the standard 20% unless a specific investment incentive certificate has been granted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of CIT payable together with results of quarterly installments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual finalization requires payment of the difference between annual CIT and total quarterly provisional payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule of related-party transactions (Phụ lục III-B/01-TNDN)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Detailed declaration of related-party transactions including value, methodology, and arm's length range.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory where the LLC has cross-border related-party transactions with non-resident shareholders or affiliates. Failure to file the schedule constitutes a separate administrative violation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties: from VND 4,000,000 to VND 20,000,000 depending on the duration of delay. Late payment interest: 0.03% per day on unpaid tax. Under-declaration penalty: 20% of the under-declared amount; understating tax by more than 10% of total payable amounts may be subject to a penalty of up to 3 times the evaded tax if fraudulent intent is established. Repeated or criminal evasion triggers prosecution under the Penal Code.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% under Vietnam domestic law on profit distributions from an LLC to its foreign corporate shareholder after CIT is fully settled, provided the company has tax clearance and audited financial statements. No separate dividend withholding tax is imposed on foreign corporate investors remitting post-tax profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief on dividends, interest, royalties, or service income, the non-resident recipient must submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the competent tax authority of the treaty jurisdiction. The Vietnamese payer withholds at the treaty rate upon receiving the TRC and a written treaty relief application before the payment date. Under applicable DTAs (e.g., with Korea, Japan, Singapore, or other treaty partners), dividend rates may be reduced to 10% or 5% depending on ownership thresholds; interest and royalty rates may be reduced to 10% or 0% depending on the treaty. The LLC should retain the TRC and treaty relief documents in its tax file. If the TRC is not provided before payment, the statutory rate applies and refund procedures under the Law on Tax Administration may be used.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties, trademarks, software licenses, and technical know-how paid to foreign parties are subject to Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT): 10% CIT + 5% VAT on gross payments (domestic statutory rates), or reduced treaty rates (typically 10% or 0% on royalties depending on the treaty). Interest paid to foreign lenders is subject to FCT at 5% CIT (plus no VAT on loans), often reduced to 0% under certain DTAs. The LLC must withhold and remit FCT on behalf of the foreign beneficiary unless treaty relief is properly documented.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VND 50 billion (total related-party revenue within the year) triggers the requirement to prepare Local File and Master File under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP. Additionally, if the ultimate parent's consolidated revenue exceeds VND 50 billion and the Vietnam entity's related-party transactions exceed VND 30 billion, the Master File is required. Country-by-Country Report filing is required for groups with consolidated revenue above VND 18,000 billion (approximately USD 750 million).
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not have a separate Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime as in hubs like the UAE. However, under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP and the General Anti-Avoidance Rules of the Law on Tax Administration, transactions must have economic substance and commercial rationale. A shell company arrangement without actual employees, office, or operational substance in Vietnam may be re-characterized, adjustments may be imputed, and penalties applied. Thin capitalization: related-party debt-to-equity ratio exceeding 5:1 results in disallowed interest deductions for CIT purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to record or deliberately understating revenue from foreign clients, use of unreported PayPal or offshore bank accounts, creation of fake invoices, or destruction of accounting books.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under Article 200 of the Penal Code: fines up to VND 4.5 billion and/or imprisonment up to 20 years depending on the amount evaded. Administrative penalties: up to 3 times the evaded tax amount plus late payment interest of 0.03% per day.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners involved in intentional tax evasion are personally liable; courts may impose imprisonment, travel bans, asset seizures, and civil restitution in addition to piercing the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Entering into cross-border transactions with related parties at non-arm's length prices; lacking adequate economic substance, personnel, and premises in Vietnam; failing to produce Local File / Master File within statutory deadlines; or submitting false TP documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax adjustment by the Vietnam tax authority to impute arm's length income; penalty of 20% of the under-declared tax, or up to 3 times the evaded tax in grave cases; late payment interest; administrative fines for late document submission up to VND 50 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign TP documentation knowingly false or who fail to ensure substance may be jointly liable for tax arrears, subject to travel bans, and criminally liable if tax evasion is demonstrated.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Excessive interest payments to overseas lenders or related parties, causing the related-party debt-to-equity ratio to exceed 5:1, or making explicit dividend distributions disguised as management fees, royalties, or service charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Interest expenses exceeding the cap are non-deductible for CIT; excess interest may be re-characterized as constructive dividends; FCT and withholding tax may be reassessed. Additional CIT and late payment interest apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute artificial profit-stripping schemes may be held personally liable for resulting tax debts and fines; travel bans and criminal sanctions are possible in cases of fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money-Laundering Concerns in Cross-Border Receipts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving payments for 3D art outsourcing services from unknown overseas parties without verifying business relationships; accepting funds through PayPal or digital wallets not properly disclosed in Vietnam; suspicious transaction structuring to avoid banking controls.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the State Bank AML regulations: fines up to VND 1 billion; criminal money-laundering liability under Article 324 of Penal Code when proceeds from crime are disguised. Accounts may be frozen; the entity may be banned from banking operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly permit or facilitate laundering through corporate accounts face imprisonment up to 15 years, personal fines, and asset forfeiture; corporate veil may be pierced to recover proceeds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Foreign Contractor Withholding / Tax Administration Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to withhold FCT on payments for services, royalties, interest, or rent to overseas providers; failure to remit withheld amounts to the State Treasury; failure to file CIT declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties for failure to withhold and remit: 100% of the tax amount not withheld (or 20%-3 times depending on severity); late payment interest; additional administrative fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the company cannot pay, directors having knowingly failed to comply may be personally assessed for unremitted withholding tax, subject to travel bans and prosecution for misappropriation of tax money.
